raw_text:
Sandeep Kumar 
Financial Analyst 
Ernakulam, Kerala  |  sandeep.kumar@example.com  |  88480XXXXX 
Summary 
Finance professional with 6 years of experience in financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis for mid-
size manufacturing firms. Known for building forecasting models that hold up under scrutiny and for clearly 
explaining financial results to non-finance stakeholders. 
Core Skills 
Technical: Financial modeling • Excel (advanced) • SAP FICO • Power BI • Variance analysis • GST & statutory 
compliance 
Additional: Cross-department coordination • Presentation to leadership • Process documentation 
Professional Experience 
Senior Financial Analyst — Trident Manufacturing Ltd, Ernakulam 
Aug 2022 – Present 
• Prepare monthly financial reports and variance analysis for senior management 
• Built a rolling 13-week cash forecast model that improved budget accuracy by 18% 
• Lead the annual budgeting process across 4 departments 
• Support statutory audit and GST filing cycles, closing audits with zero major findings 
Financial Analyst — Trident Manufacturing Ltd, Ernakulam 
Jul 2020 – Jul 2022 
• Maintained cost center reporting for 6 production units 
• Automated a manual month-end reconciliation process, saving 2 days per close cycle 
Junior Accountant — Vertex Accounting Services, Kochi 
Jul 2018 – Jun 2020 
• Handled accounts payable/receivable for 15+ SME clients 
• Assisted in monthly bank reconciliations and vendor payment cycles 
Key Achievements 
• Identified a billing discrepancy that recovered ₹12 lakh in overbilled vendor charges 
• Built the finance team's first standardized monthly reporting template, adopted company-wide 
Education 
M.Com, Finance — Mahatma Gandhi University (2016 – 2018), 8.0 CGPA 
Certifications 
• CMA (US) — Part 1 cleared (2023) 
• Advanced Excel for Finance, Coursera (2021) 

Languages 
English (fluent)  •  Malayalam (native)  •  Hindi (working proficiency) 
Professional Memberships 
• Student member, Institute of Cost Accountants of India
